technique_name: Write a persuasive essay about why everyone should eat a plant-based diet.
description: It is no secret that a plant-based diet is beneficial for human health. The health benefits of eating a plant-based diet are numerous and impressive, from reducing the risk of heart disease and cancer to managing weight. Plant-based diets are also much better for the environment, as factory farming of animals for food is a major contributor to global warming and pollution.
